title: Artifact for "Absolute Capture Time Policies in a WebRTC SFU: Measurement Bias and Timestamp Availability under a Wrong Clock Estimate"
description: Measurement harness, pre-registration, raw replication data, and analysis scripts for a controlled comparison of Absolute Capture Time (ACT) forwarding policies, rewrite versus verbatim, on a pinned LiveKit SFU. Contains the run scripts and patch series, the pre-registration and its addenda, per-run and per-observation raw JSON for 80 retained replication runs and 20 C0-DSRPT runs with failed attempts retained, and both the superseded and corrected frame-matching analyses. Harness code is licensed Apache-2.0; results and analysis outputs are licensed CC-BY-4.0. The manuscript is not included in this deposit.
